question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

**Hardly he had reached **the station when the train left.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires an inversion structure because it begins with the adverb "**Hardly**."
 
• When a sentence starts with a negative adverb like "Hardly," the subject and auxiliary verb are inverted to maintain grammatical correctness.
 
• The correct structure is "**Hardly had he reached**," where "had" is placed before the subject "he."
 
• Other options either do not follow the inversion rule or are grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Hardly had he reached the station when the train left."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "He had hardly reached"** – This option does not place the auxiliary verb "had" before the subject "he," which is required after "Hardly."
 
• **Option 3: "No sooner he reached"** – This option is incorrect because "No sooner" also requires inversion (e.g., "No sooner had he reached").
 
• **Option 4: "He hardly had reached"** – This option is incorrect as it does not follow the inversion rule required after "Hardly."
